subject: PSAD
question: A 10 kN force acts 30 degrees above the horizontal. What is its horizontal component?
explanation_tl: Kunin ang horizontal na bahagi: $F_x = 10\cos 30^\circ = 8.66$ kN
trap_a: You used sin 30° instead of cos 30°. The horizontal part uses cosine.
trap_c: You did not resolve the force. 10 kN is the whole force, not its horizontal part.
